clarity.justification: The proposal aligns its method with the question by manipulating word order, case/voice cues, and animacy in “ROLE-CONFLICT,” then measuring “REVERSAL RATE” as selection of the first noun despite a reliable cue assigning the role to the later noun. It is strongly directional and falsifiable: the core claim is rejected if reversal rates do not exceed the canonical control, and several numeric criteria are given, including “>=15 pp,” “partial correlation with cue-hierarchy distance >=0.4,” and “<5 pp repair”; these thresholds make the outcomes directly decidable. Some constructs still require clarification, especially how the “cue-hierarchy index” and “resource-level proxy” are computed and what exactly constitutes the “control” in “transfer accuracy minus control,” while “a small, causally-manipulable ‘role-binding’ representation” is broader than the operational tests can uniquely establish.

feasibility.justification: The hardest step is identifying and causally manipulating the proposed locus through “activation patching” and a “role direction = mean activation difference between agent=X and agent=Y runs”; this is a standard hook-and-intervention workflow, though the candidate-component selection and counterfactual prompting require custom engineering rather than being fully specified. The named Llama-3-8B, Aya-23-8B, and Qwen2-7B models, logistic probes, activation patching, and steering are supported by existing model-serving and interpretability tooling, and the design includes runnable negative-result controls such as “random-component control,” “label-shuffled control,” canonical-order items, animate-inanimate items, specificity tests, and translate-to-English baselines. Resources are unusually concrete: “~200 events,” “60/20/20 train/validation/test,” “3 seeds {0,1,2},” three model families, native-speaker agreement “above 0.7,” and explicit effect thresholds; the main remaining risk is methodological rather than infrastructural, because the validity of the cue index, role-forcing contexts, and causal content-preservation checks must be implemented carefully.
